covered: modular add, sub, mul, inverse and exponentiation over the P-256 prime and group order
P-256 scalar multiplication in affine and Jacobian coordinates
ECDSA signing with a supplied nonce (kinv and r through ECDSA_do_sign_ex)
ECDSA verification in both directions and rejection of a tampered signature
RSA CRT recombination and the plain private operation for one fixed 2048-bit key
not_covered: ECDSA nonce generation as an implementation under test (the RFC 6979 path is only a reference cross check)
RSA key generation by the candidate, signature padding (PKCS #1 v1.5, PSS) and OAEP
binary-level refinement between the Rust source and the DSO
boundary.proof_status: a differential observation is bounded evidence, not a proof; a green differential does not establish constant-time behaviour or memory safety
boundary.reference_status: the reference's own correctness rests on the stated reading of the normative documents
boundary.sampling: every pseudo-random population is regenerated from the recorded seed; the populations are sampled, not exhaustive
